about.title: Dentistry, designed like a studio
body: SmileCraft was built around a simple idea: a dental visit should feel considered, not clinical — from the waiting room down to how a procedure is explained.
Dr. Naveen Kumar and the team pair modern cosmetic technique with a genuinely gentle approach, for patients who've avoided the dentist for years and finally want to fix that.

blogPosts.title: Veneers vs. Whitening: What's Actually Right for Your Smile
blogPosts.excerpt: Two very different treatments that solve two very different problems — here's how to tell which one you need.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Naveen Kumar
content: Whitening changes the color of your existing teeth; veneers change their shape, size, and alignment as well as color — they solve different problems.
If your teeth are healthy and well-aligned but discolored, whitening is almost always the better first step — it's less invasive and reversible.
Veneers make sense when there's chipping, gaps, or shape issues that whitening alone can't fix, or when whitening has already reached its limit.
A good consultation should walk you through both options honestly, including trying whitening first before recommending anything irreversible.
